providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: Checked live (2026-08-26): no controlled global mosaic published by USGS. Procedural texture: darkest of the five major Uranian moons, with the single named feature Wunda (a bright-floored crater near its north pole) — rendered as a dark base with one isolated bright patch.
